title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu is hurt when Jeeva adds his special dish to the menu under Kanmani's name. Anbu erupts in anger after Nalan and Chinnaswami badmouth Kanmani's character.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma joins forces with Rishi to trap Ilamathi. Rishi catches Ilamathi off guard, arrests her, and takes her to the police station.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sarala rejoices as her relative arrives for a function after a long time. Meanwhile, Divya kickstarts Karna and Swetha's wedding celebrations by preparing the invitation cards.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi's acceptance of the wedding celebrations makes Azhagar question her hidden motive. Hoping for family unity, Pechi rejoices at Manjamalai's decision to join the ceremony.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Annapurani storms into Sneha's house, confronts and assaults Sneha and Devarajan for defaming Siva and attacking Sindhu. Sindhu is delighted when Siva shares what Annapurani did.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Thangamayil is left speechless when Sudar asks if she envies her marriage to Kumar. Saravanan fumes over Kathir's decision to attend Kumar's wedding with Gomathi and Raji.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan surprises Nila by taking her to a new home, leaving her deeply hurt. She scolds him for separating her from the family and firmly opposes his decision to move away.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu angrily confronts Arun for his harsh treatment of Seetha and demands an apology. Vijaya defends Manoj against accusations from everyone regarding Rohini's pregnancy.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi takes Meenatchi to the temple in a divine look, making Rajangam happy to see his grandchild in Goddess' attire. Later, Sethupathi dresses Azhagar as Lord Karuppu.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Despite Arjun's reluctance, Karikalan forces him onto the wedding stage to marry Swetha. As Madhu eagerly watches, Arjun feels helpless to stop the wedding.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Fake customers create chaos at Kandhasamy's mess with false food complaints. Using their claims, Arivalagan brings the Food Safety Department for an inspection.
